virtual_knobs.absolute_sync: experimental: first grab sends signed -127 to saturate at zero, then sends the displayed value; direct firmware readback remains open
virtual_knobs.subsequent_motion: host movement is sent as a signed 8-bit delta
virtual_knobs.page_change_behavior: invalidate synchronization because A..I address new functions

decision: Desktop key and mouse controls traverse the native panel UART parser. A GDB read watchpoint proved the encoder payload is a signed delta: payloads 1..10 made the native magnitude accumulator follow 0, 1, 3, 6 ... 55. The earlier wrapping-counter interpretation is superseded. Do not claim the displayed knob number is authoritative until active-page readback is mapped.

next_gate.name: AR172_QEMU_DESKTOP_CONTROL_CONTEXT_GATE
next_gate.objective: Read or infer the active page parameter values so all nine knob indicators initialize from firmware state without requiring first-grab endpoint synchronization.

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: Untouched stock firmware ran locally. No firmware, project data, factory sample names, or proprietary PCM are included.
